insights.title: ₹46L Revenue at Risk from Stockouts
insights.description: 15 SKUs face imminent stockout with ₹46L demand at risk. Top 5 replenishment actions total ₹16.7L impact, driven by salary effects (+47% demand spike), festival prep, and competitor spillovers. Clusters STR-0001, STR-0013, STR-0025 need urgent orders of 263-425 units each.
insights.action: Execute immediate replenishment orders for 1,267 total units across 5 priority store clusters within 24 hours to prevent revenue loss and capture spillover demand

insights.title: 58 SKUs Unready for Eid Event
insights.description: Eid al-Adha arrives in 20 days but 58 SKUs lack inventory ramp-up. Current demand actions show festival prep already driving +12% above forecast. Dairy & Frozen (14.4% MAPE) and Beverages (14.9% MAPE) show weakest accuracy during event cycles.
insights.action: Trigger immediate Eid demand plan review for 58 at-risk SKUs, prioritize Dairy, Frozen, and Beverages categories with accelerated safety stock buildup starting this week

insights.title: 5 Major Forecast Anomalies Requiring Model Tuning
insights.description: Open anomalies show ±19% to ±62% deviations: early salary effect (+62%), promo cannibalization (+55%), stockout cascades (-50%), competitor activity (+31%), and weather shocks (-19% Bangalore rain). Model failing to capture real-time market dynamics.
insights.action: Update forecasting model to incorporate payday calendars, competitor OOS signals, and weather APIs; retrain on recent anomaly patterns to reduce future MAPE below 10%

insights.title: Grocery & Personal Care Leading at 8.7% MAPE
insights.description: Grocery & Staples and Personal Care achieve best-in-class 8.7% MAPE vs company average 11.3%. These categories demonstrate stable demand patterns and effective forecasting, contrasting with Beverages (14.9%) and Dairy (14.4%) struggles.
insights.action: Audit forecasting methodology from Grocery/Personal Care teams and replicate best practices (feature engineering, promotional handling) to Beverages and Dairy departments
